page: Microsoft Azure EC16ads_v5 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the ECADSv5 server family. It is powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 16 dedicated vCPUs paired with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration includes 614 GB of local SSD storage and is premium storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external disk options. It does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the EC16ads_v5 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads by providing a high volume of RAM relative to the compute core count. This resource profile is designed for memory-optimized applications, including relational databases, in-memory caching layers, data analytics, and enterprise applications requiring substantial memory capacity alongside local SSD scratch space.
